name: Heltronics
old_description: Heltronics serves as a contract manufacturer of electromechanical subassemblies and box build assemblies for OEM and EMS companies. We specialize in complete box build assembly solutions—from trailer-size box builds to small power supplies. For products in robust and harsh industrial environments, Heltronics delivers the highest-quality assemblies manufactured with quality workmanship.
about:
Heltronics Inc. was established in 2008 in Reading, Pennsylvania, situated in Berks County with convenient access to Routes 222, 422, and I-76. The company operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in electromechanical and box build assemblies.

The firm provides a full suite of assembly services, including electromechanical assembly, box builds ranging from trailer-sized units to small power supplies, cable and wire harness fabrication, control panel and cabinet assembly, rework and refurbishment, and engineering and product support. Its facility is UL certified for the U.S. and Canada and staffed with IPC‑certified personnel (standards 610/620), supporting production needs from prototype runs to high‑volume monthly orders.

Heltronics serves OEMs and EMS companies across automotive, aerospace, industrial, medical, nuclear, and power and energy sectors, as well as electromedical diagnostic and electrotherapeutic device manufacturers. Customers range from startups requiring small prototype batches to large enterprises with recurring high‑volume demand.

The company emphasizes quality and customer support, holding ISO 9001:2015 certification through Dekra and membership in the Wire Harness Manufacturing Association. Its stated philosophy is to never compromise on quality, deliver quick turnaround times, and make the customer’s production goals its own.
